contract.atomicFactSet: compact `ObservationPageCommitResult@1`/Receipt（只含游标、entry count、边界和digest）+ current Field Profile Hint pointer/exact revision row验证 + current Field Observation head CAS + immutable page header revision + Procurement-owned `proc_field_observation_entries` rows + current Material physical projection（新/Reality或Binding变化才置`unknown`，不变材料不写Eligibility列）+ durable typed Result + commit marker；全部同事务成立；同一Work全部Page使用同一Hint Snapshot，Hint current pointer变化时旧Work后续Page整页rollback；Page不保存完整文件数组，不计算最终Eligibility/Region，也不发布Outbox
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Page DTO/Access/Request digest验证前后、Field observation head CAS前后、immutable revision与Material current-row逐项写入前后、typed Result/marker前后、响应前崩溃
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: 任一DTO、顺序、continuity、digest、supporting-work或CAS验证失败整页rollback；Field head、immutable page revision、全部Material current rows、typed Result和marker全有或全无；新Material仅初始化unknown/unknown；同marker重放返回原typed Result且不推进revision；terminal page以前不得形成缺失结论
